data.name: BEDROOM BRAWL
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Bedroom Brawl where your childhood toys don’t just sit in the toybox… they go to war. Step into oversized toy-filled arenas where everyday rooms turn into chaotic battlefields, and join a wild toy-wars universe filled with action, nostalgia, and infinite replayability.

A TOY WORLD BUILT FOR CHAOS

Bedrooms. Kitchens, Santa’s Workshop, Water Parks, Arcades, Garages. Toy stores. Playrooms and more!

When humans leave the room, the toys take over — turning familiar spaces into oversized arenas full of danger, creativity, and ridiculous fun.

Every map is built from a toy-scale perspective, making everyday objects feel massive, cinematic, and unpredictable fun!

ONE GAME. MULTIPLE EPIC MODES.

BEDROOM BRAWL blends several fan-favorite genres into a single connected experience — all sharing progression, unlocks, and characters for a game that NEVER STOPS being FUN!

MONSTER BATTLES WITH THE MEGA MECHS!

When all hope is lost, your final chance to win the toy war is to bring in the MEGA MECHS! Massive mechs and electric monsters to join your fight as a final chance for victory! These epic units drop in for full scale warfare, on large maps and have the power to turn the tide of battle! One of the most anticipated and fun game modes coming to our Toy world!













HERO SHOOTER ARENA COMBAT

Fast, responsive hero combat with 50+ unique toy characters, classes (healers/tank/DPS/mage/archers etc), unique abilities, explosive fun weapons, and playstyles. Tight controls, explosive action, and nonstop fun.

In Bedroom Brawl, you choose your class (tank/healer/dps/combat/support) and form a unique team to fight in multi game modes - from escorting presents to the other side of the map, capturing flags, or planting exploding presents (bomb mode). Our PVP combines many favorite game modes from other poplar games, but in our giant, crazy toy universe!

TOY KART RACING

Arcade racing at toy scale. Drift and shoot your way through bedrooms, boost off ramps, knock rivals aside, and race as your favorite toys across imaginative tracks and unlock better Karts/Guns and skills as you level up.

ZOMBIE SURVIVAL

Hold the line against relentless waves of enemies and evil toys. Upgrade gear, team up with friends, and see how long you can survive when the toys are outnumbered against the zombie invasion and monster toys!


BASE DEFENSE / TOWER DEFENSE

Build epic defenses, place traps, upgrade unique turrets, and protect your position from incoming waves. Strategy meets chaos in toy-scale warfare.

Includes some classic toy traps, including glue, toy rockets, yo-yo defense, jack in the box, pins, ooze, fidget spinner turrets, and much more! With over 50 different defensive items to pick and unlock, the FUN and CHAOS never stop!

PVP WITH FRIENDS! (RANKED & CASUAL)

Take your favorite toy online to war and play with friends, from fighting off zombies, to competitive style PVP capturing objectives or large scale 20 vs 20 warfare! 

Win rewards, gold and XP, that can all be used to unlock more toys in game that can be used across multiple game modes for ever!

OVER 20 MAPS AND MORE COMING

Battle across a growing collection of 20+ handcrafted toy-scale maps, each designed to feel massive, interactive, and packed with detail.

From familiar rooms turned into warzones to imaginative toy environments built for chaos, every map is designed around multiple game modes, keeping gameplay fresh no matter how you play.

And we’re just getting started.

New maps, new locations, and new twists are continuously added as the toy universe expands — meaning there’s always something new to explore, master, and conquer.

UNLOCK TOYS YOUR WAY

Play any mode.

Earn in-game coins.

Unlock more toys.

  • Large and growing roster of toy characters

  • All unlocks earned through gameplay

  • No pay-to-win mechanics

  • ​Every toy usable across all modes

Your collection grows as the universe grows.


 WAYS TO PLAY

From classic hero shooter action to intense wave survival and adrenaline-fueled cart races Bedroom Brawl gives you more than one way to play so its fun for all (the casual party gamers to the ultra competitive PVP):

  • Hero Shooter (Classic): Jump into tight, toy-sized arenas with unique heroes and playstyles. Expect fast, chaotic matches, over-the-top abilities, and highlight-ready action.

  • Wave / Base Defense Mode: Face waves of rogue or zombified toys. Build defenses from a huge arsenal of upgradeable fortifications and rotate weapons to withstand escalating attacks.

  • Zombie Mode: Survive relentless hordes of infected playthings that grow smarter and nastier every wave. Will you outlast the chaos or get overrun?

  • Cart Racing Mode: Strap in toy carts and race through kitchen countertops, garden tracks, and bedroom ramps mastering power-ups, shortcuts, and physics-driven mayhem.

  • Co-Op Obstacle Runs: Team up with friends to sprint through oversized obstacle courses built inside everyday rooms dodge crayons, leap over rolling marbles, solve puzzles, and race against time.

KEY FEATURES

  • Multiple Game Modes: From classic shooter to zombie survival, base defense, racing, and co-op obstacle runs — there’s no one way to play.

  • Toy-Sized Heroes & Factions: Play as members of wildly different toy factions — from classic plastic soldiers to glittery doll-blade warriors, deadly rubber-ball bouncers, and even evil cursed toys. Each comes with unique abilities and playstyles.

  • Huge, Childhood-Sized Arenas: Fight across maps inspired by real-world rooms and locations — bedrooms, toy stores, garages, backyards — but with toy-scale exaggeration. Everyday objects become cover, obstacles, or traps.

  • Fast-Paced, Replayable Action: Whether you’ve got 5 minutes or 2 hours, pick your mode and jump into action. The game embraces chaos, fun, and replayability.

  • Team-Based & Social Play: Squad up with friends — toy mayhem is always better with backup. Strategy, coordination, or just silliness: it’s your call.

  • Creative Variety: With toy-themed weapons, explosive defenses, unpredictable maps and gameplay modes, no two matches feel the same.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT!

Bedroom Brawl takes the nostalgia of childhood, mixes it with the intensity of modern shooters, and throws in a wild dose of imagination. It’s part toy-box fantasy, part chaotic shooter, and 100% fun. Whether you want a quick match, a tough survival run, or a ridiculous race on toy carts through your kitchen, this game delivers on all fronts.

Whether you grew up lining up toy soldiers across your bedroom floor, or you just love over-the-top multiplayer action with friends — Bedroom Brawl gives you a world where your childhood memories wage war. Join the toy army, pick your faction, grab your squad, and let the battles begin.

Wishlist & grab your copy today!

data.short_description: Welcome to Bedroom Brawl - A Multi Game Hero Shooter Where You Can Compete in PVP, Zombies, Tower Defense, Large Scale Mech Wars, Karting & Many More With Your Friends Playing Your Favorite Childhood Toys!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
